# NDDev CI 0.6.29

Prepared release notes. This version has not been tagged or published.

- Run project checks on managed macOS ARM64 and Linux ARM64, preserving the runner's
  prepared SDK and caches. Linux ARM64 refuses Flutter.
- Qualify the newest full verification of an exact source commit, with a separate
  receipt and verified artifact transfer. Releases use the same implementation.
- Run scheduled Renovate on an explicitly selected managed runner with scoped App
  credentials, disabled scripts/plugins and cleanup of temporary state.
- Keep one SDK ownership decision per workflow. External check selection uses only
  explicit PR labels. Dependency caches follow the lockfiles automatically.
- Remove unused release branch/title/tag-prefix options and the Renovate dry-run
  option and unused npm publication branch. Releases use dev verification, main
  publication and v version tags.
- Fix checksum creation when publishing artifact-backed releases. Update the short
  caller examples to the latest published pin.

Before adoption, pin the commit of the published release. The examples currently
pin v0.6.28; they do not claim an unreleased commit is a release.

## Qualification

Build-free source checks and isolated PC acceptance are recorded in issue #1.
The final hosted/native check, managed runner acceptance and release publication
remain pending. Python cold-download transport, private OCI reads and a public
FFmpeg provider retain their separate qualification requirements.
